subject.title: [Bug]: Telegram DMs can still land in agent:main:main, polluting heartbeat/main session after #40519

question: Should this issue be fixed narrowly by making configured `heartbeat.session` outrank event-origin session keys, or should it also change the default Telegram DM isolation behavior away from `session.dmScope: "main"`?
rationale: Current source proves the heartbeat-session priority bug remains, but current docs and tests also show main-session DM sharing is an intentional default/compatibility behavior that automation should not silently change.

options.title: Narrow Heartbeat Session Fix
options.body: Adopt or replace the linked fix so explicit heartbeat session routing wins over event-origin routing, and leave `dmScope` default policy unchanged for a separate decision.

options.title: Change DM Isolation Policy Too
options.body: Make Telegram/direct DMs isolate by default only with a documented upgrade path and doctor/config migration proof for existing users.

options.title: Document Existing Config Workaround
options.body: Keep current runtime behavior and close only after maintainers decide `session.dmScope: "per-channel-peer"` plus `heartbeat.isolatedSession` is the supported answer.

recommendation.title: Narrow Heartbeat Session Fix
recommendation.body: Adopt or replace the linked fix so explicit heartbeat session routing wins over event-origin routing, and leave `dmScope` default policy unchanged for a separate decision.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent main history points to this person on the current heartbeat runner/session-resolution code, making them the best available routing owner for the policy choice.
